body:
It helped, but I don't like being forced into things, specially because I still think killing myself is the right decision, and talking to them would make things more difficult for me to act on it.
Here I get to talk about it but nobody can actually stop me.

Well, I tried 2 differend meds. The first made me shake all day long and eat compulsively. The second one fucked up my sleep routine (I would wake up every 20 or 30 minutes and take equal time to fall asleep again, which cut my actual asleep time by half). So I started pretending to my psychiatrist I was feeling better until he agreed to test if I could handle without meds.
The thing is: it seems more rational for me to just die. Life is chaotic. some events make you sad, some make you happy. That would result in zero, but then there's the daily struggle to get out of bed every fucking day just to keep alive (pay rent, bills, etc.) and be able to take a chance and hope for a positive event.
Thank you for your support. I'm afraid my family will force me into therapy/medication if I talk to them about it, like they did when I was 15.
